complete_examples.text: A novel method (“mapping relationship model” [32,33]) for depicting the geometric relationship of the track and the embankment is introduced to calculate the additional deformation of the track induced by the frost heave effect.
The additional deformation of the track system is calculated by the “mapping relationship model”, the calculational results on Mar.
In this section, a mapping relationship model for describing the deformation behavior of track and bridge under the pier settlement is proposed.
The two proposed models, namely the dynamic interaction model and the mapping relationship model are validated by comparing the results with that of others’ work.
